criteria.text: The participant has a histologically/cytologically confirmed diagnosis of previously untreated and pathologically confirmed resectable clinical Stage II, IIIA, or IIIB (N2) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) [American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) 8th Edition]
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 within 7 days before the first dose of study intervention
The participant has not achieved a pathological complete response (pCR) following completion of neoadjuvant chemotherapy and pembrolizumab followed by surgery
The participant has no tumor-activating EGFR mutations [eg, DEL19 or L858R]
If the participant is HIV-infected, they must have well controlled HIV on anti-retroviral therapy (ART)

If the participant is hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive, they must have received hepatitis B virus (HBV) antiviral therapy for at least 4 weeks and have undetectable HBV viral load prior to randomization
If the participant has a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, their HCV viral load must be undetectable at screening

The participant has a diagnosis of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) or, for mixed tumors, presence of small cell elements, or has a neuroendocrine tumor with large-cell components, or a sarcomatoid carcinoma, or a pancoast tumor
The participant has anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) gene rearrangements
The participant received prior neoadjuvant therapy for their current NSCLC diagnosis

The participant received prior therapy with an anti-programmed cell death 1 (PD-1), anti-programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1), or anti-programmed cell-death ligand 2 (PD-L2) agent, or with an agent directed to another stimulatory or coinhibitory T-cell receptor (eg, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated protein [CTLA-4], OX-40, CD137)
The participant received prior systemic anticancer therapy including investigational agents other than what is specified in this protocol
The participant received prior treatment with a cancer vaccine
The participant received prior radiotherapy within 2 weeks of start of study intervention, or has radiation-related toxicities, requiring corticosteroids
The participant received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose of study intervention

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) With or Without Intismeran Autogene (V940) in Participants With Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (V940-009/INTerpath-009)". Your earlier answers already covered 6 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: After finishing neoadjuvant chemotherapy and pembrolizumab, did you have surgery? If so, did the pathology report show a pathological complete response (pCR), meaning no cancer cells were found in the removed tissue?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No surgery. They said the tumor was too big to take out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you have HIV, are you currently taking anti-retroviral therapy (ART) to keep it well controlled? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Never been tested, so I couldn't say.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever been diagnosed with Hepatitis C (HCV)? If you have, do you know if your current viral load is undetectable? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Never checked, so I couldn't say.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever been tested for anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) gene rearrangements? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No clue. I don't know if they tested for that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Before your current lung cancer diagnosis, did you receive any chemotherapy or other cancer treatments to shrink the tumor before surgery? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any chemo yet. I just got diagnosed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever received treatment with immunotherapy drugs that target the immune system, such as PD-1, PD-L1, PD-L2, CTLA-4, OX-40, or CD137? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't started any treatment yet. I just got diagnosed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever received treatment with a cancer vaccine? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any cancer vaccines. I haven't had any treatment at all yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had any radiation therapy for your cancer in the last 2 weeks? Also, are you currently taking corticosteroid medications (like prednisone) to manage any side effects from past radiation?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No radiation at all. And I don't take any steroid pills like prednisone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you received any live vaccines (like MMR, varicella, or the nasal flu spray) in the last 30 days?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any live vaccines recently. I'm just trying to stay healthy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
